label: Bible Study
prompt: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good _____, and do it.
verse: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
note: Ezra was on his face weeping over the people's sin — Shechaniah tells him to get up, take heart, and lead.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou art my _____ place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verse: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
note: God as a hiding place who surrounds David with songs of deliverance — a shelter with a soundtrack.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a _____; and Moses fled from before it.
verse: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
note: Moses' shepherd rod hit the ground as a serpent — and the future deliverer of Israel ran from it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get _____, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
verse: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
note: Moses' warning for prosperous days: the power to earn is itself a gift, so don't forget the Giver.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore let him that thinketh he _____ take heed lest he fall.
verse: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
note: Right after recounting Israel's wilderness failures: 'let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.'
